"Drop backs scattered throughout the river top to bottom. Upper end still holds some spawning steelhead. Smallmouth bass showing in the lower sections. About the Lodge

Right on the River.
Real Fishing Country.

Situated directly on the world-renowned Salmon River in Pulaski, NY, Steelhead Lodge is your four-season home base for trophy steelhead and salmon fishing, river tubing, and honest home cooking at Joe's Smokehouse.

We're not a resort — we're a fishing lodge. Your guides know every pool. The cooking draws guests back year after year. And the wood smoke from Joe's drifts across the deck all afternoon.

River Tubing & Kayaking

You Don't Have to Fish
to Love the River

Grab a tube, let the Salmon River carry you, and end the day at Joe's Smokehouse. No fishing license required.

Book a Tubing Trip

"Pure relaxation on the river"

How It Works

1
Arrive at the LodgePick up your tube & gear — we handle everything
2
We Drop You UpstreamShuttle to the put-in — sit back and float
3
Float the Salmon RiverGorgeous scenery, gentle current, pure summer fun
4
We Pick You UpMeet you at the take-out — no stress, no logistics
5
Feast at Joe's SmokehouseBBQ ribs on the river — you've earned it

"Perfect for groups & friends"

Good to Know

How long is the float? Typically 2-3 hours depending on current flow. Perfect half-day adventure.
Is it safe for kids? Yes! At 250–600 CFS it's gentle and safe for all ages. Check our live tubing status above before booking.
What should I wear? Swimsuit, water shoes or sandals, sunscreen. Bring a dry bag for valuables. We provide life jackets.
Do I need experience? Zero experience needed. If you can sit in a tube, you can do this. It's that easy.
What's the best season? June through August is prime tubing season. Check the live conditions panel above for real-time flow status.

Guided Trips

Fish the Salmon River
with a Local Expert

Our guides know every pool, run, and riffle on this river. Chasing trophy Kings in October or winter steelhead in February — we put you on fish.

Drift Boat — Full Day

Cover miles of river from a drift boat. Our guides navigate the best pools all day. Spin, float, and fly fishing available. 8 hours from launch.

$375 · 1 angler / $475 · 2 anglersALL TACKLE & EQUIPMENT PROVIDED

Guided Wade — Full Day

Get intimate with the river. Your guide positions you in the productive runs and teaches you the techniques that work. 6-8 hours of serious fishing.

$325 · 1 angler / $425 · 2 anglersALL TACKLE & EQUIPMENT PROVIDED

Fishing Calendar

🍂

Fall · Sept–Nov

Peak season. King & Coho Salmon run strong. Early steelhead enter in October.

❄️

Winter · Dec–Feb

Chrome steelhead in solitude. Fewer crowds, serious fish. Winter value rates.

🌱

Spring · Mar–May

Steelhead drop-back. Brown trout active. Prime wade fishing as clarity improves.

☀️

Summer · Jun–Aug

River tubing, kayaking, ATV trails. Best season for families and non-anglers.
